title: Thai-Style Lentil Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious dish that combines the warmth of lentils with the aromatic spices of Thai cuisine. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the Thai Pilaf Rice Mix and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Stir in the lentils, Thai Red Curry Paste, and salt.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Fluff with a fork and serve hot.
